name: Somalia
shortSummary: India's engagement with Somalia has been shaped mainly by counter-piracy naval operations off its coast, given the country's prolonged instability.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: The Indian Navy has conducted counter-piracy patrols in waters off the Somali coast.

majorChallenges.title: Prolonged instability
majorChallenges.description: Somalia's security situation severely limits broader bilateral engagement.

sources.title: Bilateral brief
